does_not_do: It implements the protocol; settlement depends on the payment networks and facilitators the user chooses.
focus_reason: The reference code for the protocol, with unit and end-to-end tests. 32 package versions in the year; 422 open issues.
measured_against: Need: implement or inspect HTTP payment flows for machine and agent payments.
tests_ci: Unit-test and end-to-end test workflows, plus per-language checks (Go, Python, Java) and linting.
what_it_is: Reference implementations of x402, an open standard for payments over HTTP, in TypeScript, Python, Go and Java. coinbase/x402 is now a development fork of this repository.
